name: io.github.WYRE-AI/dandh-mcp
title: D&H Distributing
description: MCP server for D&H Distributing — REST and XML pricing, availability, item search, order tracking, and order placement.

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: REST API OAuth Client ID from the D&H API Portal application (Customer Order Management API enabled). Set the full REST set (client id, secret, account number) or none.

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: REST API OAuth Client Secret from the D&H API Portal application

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_ACCOUNT_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: 10-digit D&H customer account number used in REST paths

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_COMPANY
environmentVariables.description: D&H company / tenant for REST calls: us, ca, or dsc

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_XML_USER_CODE
environmentVariables.description: dandh.com / dandh.ca UserCode enabled for D&H Automation Services (XML). Set the full XML set (user code, password) or none.

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_XML_COUNTRY
environmentVariables.description: D&H XML site: us (dandh.com) or ca (dandh.ca)

environmentVariables.name: DANDH_ENVIRONMENT
environmentVariables.description: production or test; selects the D&H OAuth and REST API hosts (XML always uses the live XML endpoint)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server. Set to 'stdio' for local CLI use; the image defaults to 'http' for gateway hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AUTH_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Credential source: 'env' reads vars locally, 'gateway' expects header injection from the WYRE MCP Gateway.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log verbosity: debug, info, warn, error
